brief.purpose: Produce a clear, well-argued text on the topic in the topic source.
brief.task: Draft the text, critique it, revise it and edit it into its final form.
success_criteria: The text meets every requirement in the topic source.
Its argument is sound and its structure easy to follow.
It reads clearly and suits its audience.

topic.inline: <the topic, audience, length and any other requirements for the text>

writer.instructions: You write and revise the text.

structure_critic.instructions: You critique structure and argument: order, logic, evidence, gaps and claims that are not supported.

style_critic.instructions: You critique style and clarity: wording, tone, length, readability and fit for the audience.

layers.instructions: Write a complete first draft of the text described in the topic source. Reply with the draft only.
Critique the draft from your angle only. List concrete problems, each with where it occurs and how to fix it, most important first. Do not rewrite the text.
Revise your draft using both critiques. Apply what improves the text; where you reject a point, keep your version. Reply with the full revised text only.

Edit the revised text into its final form, checking it against the topic source. Reply with the final text only, then end with a short section headed '## Notes' listing what changed from the first draft and why.
